Name: Aaron's Ping-Pong
Overview:
Aaron's Ping-Pong is a indie game version of Pong, with virtually identical gameplay. The game area is entirely black, and has two paddles on the left and right, with a ball going between the two and it is up to the player to prevent the ball from getting past his paddle whilst directing it past the AI controlled paddle on the opposite side.

A two player mode is also supported to allow a second player to take control of the opposing paddle for a head to head game on the same Xbox 360.
